system.description:
You spin your weapon with enough force to upheave gravel, stone and even water particles before swiping and maintaining the stance needed to hunt even demons with.

Select one creature you can see in range. That creature becomes the Demon you are hunting for the duration. While in initiative with your Demon you gain a +20 bonus to your movement speed and damage you deal with your polearm against this Demon ignores Resistance and treats immunity as resistance.

Additionally, when you cast a Bukijutsu with the same Polearm used to cast this jutsu, it gains a +1 bonus to its Save DCs and increases the range of its attacks by +5 Feet.

Chain 2: You can select one additional Creature to be your Hunted Demon.

Chain 3: If your hunted demon would trigger an attack of opportunity from you, you can make two weapon attacks against them as part of that attack of opportunity. If at least one score a hit, you regain the reaction spent to take the attack of opportunity.
